description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'StoreBreadcrumbsTag' that generates a breadcrumb navigation URL segment based on the current request's breadcrumb attribute and specified category or product IDs.

classes.name: StoreBreadcrumbsTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that constructs a breadcrumb URL segment based on the current HTTP request attributes and input category/product IDs.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs a breadcrumb URL segment based on the request's breadcrumb attribute and category ID.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses a breadcrumb reference string to extract category IDs as a list of strings.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Indicates the tag processing is complete and evaluation should continue.

methods.name: getCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the category ID set for the tag.

methods.name: setCategoryId
methods.description: Sets the category ID for the tag.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID set for the tag.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID for the tag.
